metadata.name: Ecobank Transnational Inc. (ETI)
metadata.provenance: financials built 26-Nov-26 from ETI FY2024 Audited & 9M 2026 NGX Statements + S&P Nov-26 Stable Outlook; quotes await [BBG]

financials_multi_year.source: Ecobank Transnational FY2024 Audited NGX Statements, read 26-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY24 net rev $2.10bn (+18% CC; NII $1.20bn + NIR $914m), CIR record low 53.0%, PBT $658m, PAT attributable $333m (+45% CC), CAR 15.8%, NPL 6.7%, CoR 1.79%.

financials_multi_year.source: Ecobank Transnational 9M 2026 Unaudited NGX Statements & S&P Nov-26 Review, read 26-Nov-26

observations.notes: 9M26 gross earnings $2,551.2m (+11% YoY), revenue $1,962.1m (+12% YoY), PBT $736.9m (+12% YoY), assets $36.0bn. Subsidiary Ecobank Nigeria repaid $300m Eurobond in Feb-26; S&P revised ETI Outlook to Stable (B-/B) in Nov-26.

capital_structure_tranches.observation: Issued under ETI Sustainable Finance programme; Ecobank Nigeria $300m senior bond fully repaid Feb-26.

debt_maturities.source: ETI $450m Tier 2 Sustainable Notes post Feb-26 Ecobank Nigeria $300m repayment.

verdict.stance: Overweight / Pan-African Franchise Post-Nigeria Bond Repayment (S&P B- Stable Nov-26)
verdict.summary: ETI grew 9M26 revenue 12% YoY to $1,962m and PBT 12% to $736.9m ($36.0bn assets), while Ecobank Nigeria cleanly repaid its $300m Eurobond in Feb-26. In Nov-26 S&P revised ETI's B-/B outlook to Stable on resolved subsidiary debt risks and resilient UEMOA/Anglophone cash flows.

positives: S&P revised Outlook to Stable (Nov-26) following Ecobank Nigeria $300m Eurobond repayment.
35-country diversification with 53% CIR and 9M26 PBT up 12% to $736.9m.
Established Pan-Africa (Togo) banking franchise with systemic liquidity access and regulatory oversight.
negatives: Nigeria/Ghana sovereign & FX volatility (6.7% FY24 NPLs).
HoldCo structural subordination to operating bank subsidiaries.
Direct linkage to Pan-Africa (Togo) sovereign credit ceiling, local policy rate cycles, and FX volatility.

background.business_overview: Pan-African banking group operating across 35 countries from Lomé, Togo.
background.ownership_governance: Nedbank (~21%), Qatar National Bank (~20%), PIC; NGX/BRVM/GSE listed.

recent_drivers: Nov-26: S&P revised B-/B Outlook to Stable; 9M26 rev $1.96bn (+12%), PBT $736.9m (+12%), assets $36.0bn.
2024A: FY24 net rev $2.10bn (+18% CC; NII $1.20bn + NIR $914m), CIR record low 53.0%, PBT $658m, PAT attributable $333m (+45% CC), CAR 15.8%, NPL 6.7%, CoR 1.79%.
